title: Standing to one side, the deity Uttara recited this verse in the presence of the Blessed One: Life is swept along, Short is the lifespan…
content:
Standing to one side, the deity Uttara recited this verse in the presence of the Blessed One:
Life is swept along,
Short is the lifespan —
To old age we are led,
There is no stopping place.
Seeing this danger in death,
Do meritorious deeds
That bring true happiness.

Life is swept along,
Short is the lifespan —
To old age we are led,
There is no stopping place.
Seeing this danger in death,
Seeking peace, abandon worldly hopes.

title: “Cunda, just as all unwholesome states tend downward and all wholesome states tend upward. So too, Cunda: the harmless person is higher than the harmful…
content: “Cunda, just as all unwholesome states tend downward and all wholesome states tend upward. So too, Cunda: the harmless person is higher than the harmful person; the person who abstains from killing is higher than the killer; the person who abstains from taking what is not given is higher than the taker of what is not given; the person unsmeared by the world, not clinging to personal views, of easy disposition and equanimity, is higher than the person smeared by the world, clinging to personal views, of difficult disposition and lacking equanimity.”

title: Then the Blessed One gave progressive instruction to the brahmin Pokkharasādi, namely: talk on giving, talk on virtue, talk on the heavens; he explained the…
content: Then the Blessed One gave progressive instruction to the brahmin Pokkharasādi, namely: talk on giving, talk on virtue, talk on the heavens; he explained the danger, degradation, and defilement of sensual pleasures, and the benefit of renunciation. When the Blessed One knew that the brahmin Pokkharasādi’s mind was ready, pliant, free from hindrances, uplifted, and confident, he then taught the Dhamma that the Buddhas have realized, namely: suffering, origin, cessation, and path. Just as a clean cloth, freed from black stains, would properly absorb dye, so too, right there in that seat, the dust-free, stainless Dhamma-eye arose in the brahmin Pokkharasādi: ‘Whatever is subject to origination is all subject to cessation.’

title: “I do not see any other thing, monks, that leads to such great benefit as heedfulness. Heedfulness, monks, leads to great benefit.”
content: “I do not see any other thing, monks, that leads to such great benefit as heedfulness. Heedfulness, monks, leads to great benefit.”

title: Venerable Jatukaṇṇī: “Having heard of the hero, free from desire for sensual pleasures, I have come to ask the desireless one, Who has crossed the…
content:
Venerable Jatukaṇṇī:
“Having heard of the hero, free from desire for sensual pleasures,
I have come to ask the desireless one,
Who has crossed the flood,
The one born with the eye —
Speak the path of peace,
Let the Blessed One tell it to me as it is.

Having conquered sensual desires,
The Blessed One lives in the world
Like the sun illuminating the earth with its radiance.
O great wise one, teach me the Dhamma —
I am of little wisdom —
That by knowing it, I might overcome birth and old age.”

The Blessed One replied to Jatukaṇṇī:
“Subdue greed for sensual pleasures,
See renunciation as peace.
Do not hold on to or reject anything in the world.

Dry up what has gone before,
Let there be nothing after —
If you grasp nothing in the middle,
You will live at peace.

For one who has no ‘mine’ at all
In name-and-form, O brahmin,
There are no defilements by which
One would be in death’s power.”

title: “‘Māra, Māra,’ venerable sir, is said. What, venerable sir, is Māra?” - “Form, Rādha, is Māra. Feeling is Māra. Perception is Māra. Formations are Māra.…
content: “‘Māra, Māra,’ venerable sir, is said. What, venerable sir, is Māra?” - “Form, Rādha, is Māra. Feeling is Māra. Perception is Māra. Formations are Māra. Consciousness is Māra. Seeing thus, Rādha, a well-taught noble disciple becomes disenchanted with form … with feeling … with perception … with formations … with consciousness. Being disenchanted, he becomes dispassionate. Through dispassion, he is liberated. In liberation, knowledge arises: ‘Liberated.’ He knows: ‘Birth is destroyed, the holy life has been lived, what had to be done has been done, there is no more of this state of being.’”

title: “Monks, as long as the community of monks is not dominated by craving — that craving which leads to another state of existence — then,…
content: “Monks, as long as the community of monks is not dominated by craving — that craving which leads to another state of existence — then, monks, the community of monks can be expected to prosper and not decline.”

title: “Monks, wander in your own proper range, in your own ancestral territory. Monks, if you wander in your own proper range, in your own ancestral…
content: “Monks, wander in your own proper range, in your own ancestral territory. Monks, if you wander in your own proper range, in your own ancestral territory, then longevity will increase, beauty will increase, ease will increase, wealth will increase, power will increase.”

title: “Monks, these six sense bases — unguarded, unprotected, unguarded, unrestrained — bring suffering. What six? The eye sense base, monks — unguarded, unprotected, unguarded, unrestrained…
content: “Monks, these six sense bases — unguarded, unprotected, unguarded, unrestrained — bring suffering. What six? The eye sense base, monks — unguarded, unprotected, unguarded, unrestrained — brings suffering. The ear … The nose … The tongue … The body … The mind sense base, monks — unguarded, unprotected, unguarded, unrestrained — brings suffering. These six sense bases, monks — unguarded, unprotected, unguarded, unrestrained — bring suffering.”

title: “Monks, misconduct in sensual pleasures, when performed, developed, and cultivated, leads to hell, to the animal realm, to the realm of hungry ghosts. The very…
content: “Monks, misconduct in sensual pleasures, when performed, developed, and cultivated, leads to hell, to the animal realm, to the realm of hungry ghosts. The very least result of misconduct in sensual pleasures is being born human with enmity from adversaries.”
